finding: Nested-folder warning is diagnostic log/stdout. It has no protocol prefix and matches no progress-line form, so current ES transfer/card consumers do not display its sentence. Actual backup result frame is separately pending.

excerpts.text:
local nested_key nested_val nested_what
    for nested_key in SETTINGS_REMOTE CONTENT_REMOTE; do
        nested_val="${!nested_key}"
        [ -n "${nested_val}" ] && [ -n "${SAVES_REMOTE%/}" ] || continue
        case "${nested_val%/}/" in
            "${SAVES_REMOTE%/}/"?*)
                log_message "${nested_key}=${nested_val} is inside SAVES_REMOTE=${SAVES_REMOTE}" "false" "WARN"
                if [ "${nested_key}" = "SETTINGS_REMOTE" ]; then nested_what="settings folder"; else nested_what="ROMs and BIOS folder"; fi
                [ "${AUTOMATIC}" -eq 1 ] || log_message "Your ${nested_what} in the cloud sits inside your saves folder. Linking cloud storage does not move these files. You can choose separate folders in MANAGE CLOUD STORAGE." "true" "WARN"
                ;;
        esac
    done

supplemental_result.finding: Both nested warnings actually fired in the retained synthetic backup log. ES displayed normal COMPLETED outcome; diagnostic sentence was not displayed. Plain log lines are dropped by the unchanged CloudTransferJob parser.
